references.text: A parallel in Jacob's persistence and demand for a condition before letting go, highlighting his character both in business negotiations and in his spiritual struggle.
Both verses illustrate Jacob's strategy of using gifts and promises to secure favor and reconciliation in conflict-filled meetings.
Both verses show Jacob's use of the title 'your servant' and gift strategies in conflict-filled relationships, highlighting his development from negotiator to reconciler.
A contrasting parallel that highlights Jacob's character development: from a covenant with God (Gen 28:20) to a calculated business deal with Laban (Gen 30:31).
